$comment: Targets. The USER declares them through `python3 -m harness target set <stock> <value> --by user --why "..."`.
The agent never writes this file. The pre-write hook denies a hand edit.
Current values do not live here. `python3 -m harness state` computes them on every run.
A stored current value rots in silence, and then a reader treats it as a measurement.
Every target records who decided it, when, and why. A target without an author becomes the agent's target.
